metaDescription: Order custom straight fit shirts for your team. Bulk pricing, fast turnaround. Get a quote today at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Straight fit shirts offer a classic, relaxed silhouette that skims the body without being tight or overly loose. This timeless cut works well for corporate uniforms, team apparel, and promotional giveaways because it flatters a wide range of body types. From sustainable button-downs to durable work shirts, our straight fit options in cotton, blends, and performance fabrics can be embroidered or screen printed with your logo. Choose straight fit for a professional look that stays comfortable all day.
heroAltText: Custom straight fit shirts for men and women in various colors with embroidered logos
